_comment: Feeds and countries deliberately removed from the catalog. 'excluded': feed URLs, matched by normalised URL, so an upstream re-sync can never reintroduce them; entry {"feedURL": "https://...", "reason": "why", "date": "YYYY-MM-DD"}. validate.py appends here when it prunes a feed after 3 consecutive monthly failures. 'excludedRegions': whole countries, by ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code; entry {"id": "XX", "reason": "why", "date": "YYYY-MM-DD"}. Their upstream country list is skipped and no feed tagged with them is published.

excludedRegions.reason: Removed at the maintainer's request (RumskrotSyndicate#362): no Russia category and no Russian feeds.
